examples.description: Add a short title for the first 3 seconds

description: Add a text clip to the first text track, or to the one track_id names (a later text track draws over an earlier one). Pick a semantic preset (title/subtitle/lower_third/callout/price_tag) — it carries complete opinionated styling; override only what matters. Keep text SHORT (max 5-7 words).

content.description: The text (max 500 chars; aim for 5-7 words).

duration_ms.description: Visible time; keep text readable (3-5s minimum).

project_id.description: The studio project (vp_…) this tool acts on.

track_id.description: A text track (vtr_) from get_composition; defaults to the first one.

name: studio.add_text_overlay
